messages:
deploybot: PRE-FLIGHT: env-parity check failed for service=keystore. Missing secret key in prod: KEY_STORE_ALIAS. Release paused.
joel: taking this. @anita any recent keystore rotations?
anita: i rotated keystore for staging at 2026-03-20T04:10UTC and updated overlays there. prod overlays were not updated  looks like only staging picked up `keystore/alias/v4`.
joel: quick check: `kubectl -n infra get secret keystore -o jsonpath='{.data.alias}' | base64 --decode` -> staging: `keystore/alias/v4` prod: `keystore/alias/v3`.
ops: deploy window ends in 25m. hotpatch would need a KMS write; we don't grant that during planned windows unless emergency.
release-eng: options: 1) hotpatch prod secret to v4 (fast but requires privileged op), 2) rollback to previous image that supports v3, 3) flip a compatibility flag in runtime (requires deploy).
anita: the new runtime expects alias v4 for a performance fix. fallback to v3 removed in the last build.
joel: rollback PR ready to pin image `registry/redwood/keystore:20260319-compat` if we choose rollback. I can open it in ~8m.
ops: prefer rollback to minimize privileged writes. Also create follow-up for deploybot to validate secret decoded content equality across envs.
release-eng: decision: apply rollback and hold promotion until 08:00UTC tomorrow. If hotpatch becomes feasible with Ops approval in <15m we'll reconsider.
anita: preparing rollback changelog entry. ETA 10m.
joel: applying rollback: `kubectl -n infra set image deploy/keystore keystore=registry/redwood/keystore:20260319-compat`
deploybot: detected image change, running post-deploy health checks.
ops: monitoring metrics + logs, tails look clean.
release-eng: post-action: created ticket RL-4300 (deploybot secret-content parity) and RL-4301 (runbook: keystore rotation checklist).
anita: i'll coordinate a controlled keystore reconciliation during next maintenance window. Apologies team.
joel: rollback successful, health checks green. updating release notes: "rollback: pinned keystore image due to keystore alias rotation mismatch between staging and prod; follow-ups created."
deploybot: thread closed after post-deploy success check.
